review_limitations: No claim of continuous audiovisual perception from browser screenshots. The word boundaries are approximate, not precise phoneme alignment. Empty onset test is insufficient measurement, not proof of bad sync. Mouth-aperture correlation is weak; its failed comparison is preserved, not equated with a demonstrated wrong phoneme. These limits prevent unqualified perceptual sync clearance.
assessment: Visually plausible and mechanically intact, but sync review remains flagged and unresolved. No clear sustained gross mismatch was established in samples. Do not automatically conform or integrate.
